Name: Young Linus overhaul
Author: bluestarkiller
Description:
After some feedback regarding my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1185/?]young shirtless Linus[/url] mod, I decided to give young shirtless Linus him a beard and different hair colors.

Now you have 6 hair colors to choose from:

Black hair
Blonde
Brunette
Ginger
Sandy Blonde
Original White hair

And 3 beard styles:
Shaved
Trimmed
Full beard

They all come with matching overworld sprites!


[size=4][u]To install:[/u][/size]

Download the folder of the beard type you want, then copy the contents inside the folder of the hair color you want and paste them into your "Contents" folder.
Remember to always keep a copy of your original file if you want to uninstall this mod!


Please also check out my other Linus mod: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1177/?]A house for Linus[/url]
